reforms.description: An investment tax credit was introduced for the first time, aimed at encouraging investments in energy-saving and pollution control initiatives.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: The tax credit incentivizes private sector investment in energy-saving technologies, which can enhance productivity and innovation.
reforms.status_evidence: The investment tax credit was introduced and is currently in effect.
reforms.importance_rationale: While significant, the reform is not a structural change but rather an introduction of a new incentive.
reforms.source_quote: A tax rebate of 300 billion yen was granted to households and an investment tax credit was introduced for the first time.

reforms.description: The 'Employment Stabilisation Fund' was established to provide subsidies to firms hiring older workers, aimed at addressing unemployment among this demographic.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: By providing subsidies for hiring older workers, the fund aims to reduce unemployment and enhance the labor market's efficiency.
reforms.status_evidence: The fund has been established and is currently operational.
reforms.importance_rationale: The establishment of the fund is significant for addressing demographic unemployment but does not represent a systemic overhaul.
reforms.source_quote: In FY 1978 the 'Employment Stabilisation Fund' started to grant subsidies to firms recruiting workers between 45 and 64 years of age.
